It also provides a basis on how marketers and businesses can utilize algorithmic properties and develop networking models for their products to reach more targeted clients. It examines the algorithms to understand the users’ consumption for the benefit of influencers and sellers. This work also examines the ways in which renewable energy (RE) sources can be forecasted using these techniques.

articleTitle: A Review on Prognosis and Remaining Useful Life Estimation of Electrical Drives & Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Smart Technologies for Power and Renewable Energy (SPECon)
abstract: This paper will anthologize the work done in the field of condition monitoring in general and prognosis and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation of electric drives/machines in particular since last few years. It will briefly present the general prognosis procedure, different types of prognosis techniques and their comparative study inclusively the work done by researchers from academia and industries. Now a days Condition Based Maintenance (CBM) is also getting attention in industries, with this aspect also prognosis in general or with the propagation of fault becomes vital. The CBM is comprised with prognosis strategy as the next step to the fault diagnosis. However, the fault diagnosis is useful in maintenance scheduling, the study of fault propagation and life estimation using prognostics techniques can allow felicitous diminution of the fault subsequently will increase reliability of the machine. It is important in continuous health monitoring, timely maintenance scheduling, risk of failure analysis and remaining life prediction. The study present here will be helpful to the researchers working in prognosis and RUL estimation of electrical drives and machines. There are several papers presenting reviews but this paper provides the literature summary according to the prognosis techniques and compiles them in a common section. In addition, a common conclusive table is also provided invoking the key features, merits and demerits of all the techniques available.

articleTitle: Power quality analysis using adaptive controller based SAPF under different loading scenario
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Smart Technologies for Power and Renewable Energy (SPECon)
abstract: The use of power electronics devices and their control is widespread in both home and commercial applications. When these loads are attached to the structure, they cause the system to experience highly nonlinear current draws and harmonics. Harmonics introduced into the system result in a reduction in power quality (PQ) and a drop in system efficiency. Conventional passive filters have been recognized for their ability to diminish harmonic currents. Nevertheless, these filters have drawbacks such as their substantial dimensions and the inability to change the harmonic order. This study employs a shunt active power filter (SAPF) to improve the PQ and reduce current harmonics. The SAPF is employed to measure the intensity of harmonics. The SAPF utilizes fuzzy logic controllers for the regulation of the DC-link voltage, adaptive hysteresis current controllers for the generation of switching pulses, and modified synchronous reference frame (MSRF) technology for the generation of reference currents. The suggested controller efficiently reduces harmonics in the presence of different load. The results indicate that the suggested controller, effectively reduces the Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) of the source current different loading scenario.

articleTitle: Synchrophasor Enabled Energy Monitoring, Management and Control of Solar PV-Battery Interfaced Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Smart Technologies for Power and Renewable Energy (SPECon)
abstract: The incorporation of renewable energy sources, such as Solar Photovoltaic (SPV) systems with battery storage in microgrids has gained significance in response to rising energy demand and the need for sustainable power solutions. However, the management and regulation of those systems provide a variety of intricate difficulties, including but not limited to energy management, grid stability and resource optimisation. The proposed work aims to address these challenges by leveraging Synchrophasor Technology (ST) using Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs), controllers and converters to enable comprehensive monitoring, management, and control of SPV-battery interfaced microgrids. In terms of effectiveness, cost, and system size, a single-stage SPV system with an MPPT is also more suited for a grid-connected microgrid. Energy management is also proposed by a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) with a bidirectional DC-DC converter and a Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) in the SPV system since intermittent energy output might not be able to meet energy demand. The work also aims to create a coordinated control of a single-stage SPV real power injection with the incorporation of the battery’s performance to achieve optimal power harvest from the SPV module as well as real power injection through battery health monitoring even in fault scenarios. The whole system was modelled in MATLAB/Simulink and the performance characteristics were analysed to show that the PMUs and controllers in conjunction with the VSC and converter monitor and manage the SPV and BESS power effectively.

articleTitle: Control Strategy for Harmonic Compensation of Three Phase Four Wire UPQC with Conventional and AI Controllers
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Smart Technologies for Power and Renewable Energy (SPECon)
abstract: To reduce reactive power problems, harmonics, voltage flicker/imbalance, and negative sequence current in power distribution systems with Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC). A four-wire, three-phase system is the intended use for this specific architecture. In this novel topology, the series active filter is configured with three legs, while the shunt active filter is equipped with four legs, deviating from the conventional three-leg configuration. This modification is implemented to eliminate the need for series capacitors in the shunt active filter and avoidable issues related to capacitor voltage balancing. The UPQC model in the paper incorporates PI controllers, fuzzy logic controllers, and neural networks. The controllers play a crucial role in regulating the UPQC system, ensuring its optimal performance. A THD comparison table is developed to compare the effectiveness of the PI controllers, fuzzy logic controllers, and neural networks. The proposed performance of the methodology is thoroughly evaluated through MATLAB simulation. The combination of innovative topology design and controller strategies showcases the potential for improved power quality in real-world applications.

Author Keywords: Fuzzy logic and neural network controller

articleTitle: Research Trends in Energy Consumption within the Cryptocurrency Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Smart Technologies for Power and Renewable Energy (SPECon)
abstract: The emergence of eryptocurrencies has not only revolutionized financial markets but has also raised concerns about their significant energy consumption and environmental impact. This study focuses on conducting a bibliometric analysis to explore the relationship among the energy consumption and cryptocurrencies. Initially 431 research articles were extracted for the database. The research data was collected from reputable databases like Scopus and filtered based on predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. Finally, 390 research articles were finalized for analysis like Bradfords law, lotka law, most cited author, most cited country, most cited document, co-word analysis, Co-occurrence keyword and Thematic Map to understand the energy consumption by cryptocurrency. By systematically reviewing scholarly literature, this study aims to identify key themes, trends, and research gaps in the domain of energy consumption in cryptocurrencies. Understanding the energy implications of cryptocurrencies is vital for addressing environmental concerns and developing sustainable solutions. Through the synthesis and analysis of existing scholarly work, this study contributes to a broader understanding of the topic and provides guidance for future research in this rapidly evolving field.
